title: Chapter 299: Bunch of Actors!
html:
Because the camera sat atop the television, the screen showed exactly what Chen Ge would see if he turned around. Crouched before the flickering image, he felt less as though he were watching an old recording than observing what was happening behind him at that very moment.

The lights continued pulsing until those in the apartment matched the recording’s rhythm. Whenever the filmed room darkened, reality dimmed with it; both brightened again at precisely the same instant.

The video is influencing reality? No, the ghosts are playing tricks on me.

Chen Ge refused to turn. He watched the bedroom door on-screen inch open whenever the light faded. At the seventh flicker, a mass of black hair emerged from behind it.

The hair is long, should be a woman. Could she be the second tenant?

Still he did not turn, though his grip tightened around the hammer. At the eighth flicker, the hair stirred and half a face leaned into the living room. Chen Ge stared at it while counting silently. The intervals between each pulse appeared perfectly regular.

When the face in the video was about to show itself, the light in the video and in reality suddenly shut off at the same time!

“Xu Yin!” Chen Ge reacted instantly, swinging the hammer behind him.

The hammer struck a soft cushion. Chen Ge scanned the dark room as something shifted within it. Several seconds later, the light returned. The living room appeared unchanged—except that the bedroom door now stood open, exactly as it had in the recording.

Chen Ge looked back at the television. White static filled the screen; the recording had ended. He kicked aside the sofa and watched the tape continue turning. When Xu Yin’s voice sounded again, Chen Ge approached the bedroom. Its door stood halfway open, with several strands of long hair scattered across the floor. He picked them up and rubbed them between his fingers.

“If you are intent on trying my patience like this, I might just torch the whole place down.”

The bedroom was a wreck. Trash littered the floor, wooden planks covered the wardrobe, and even the bedside table had been nailed shut.

Everything that can be opened is sealed up. What is this furniture hiding? Which tenant left the videotapes behind?

The sealed furniture suggested an explanation. Did the tenant discover the haunting’s source in those recordings and then nail every drawer and cabinet closed?

The theory grew more convincing. The tenant had probably recorded a ghost emerging from a piece of furniture, then sealed everything that opened in an attempt to keep it contained.

Standing at the room’s center, Chen Ge noticed a flaw. Including that woman, I’ve encountered three ghosts, and every one moves freely through the apartment. Sealing the furniture accomplished nothing. The tenant must have overlooked one drawer—the one I’m searching for.

He stationed Xiaoxiao at the bedroom door as a lookout, then used the hammer to pry open every drawer and cabinet. Everything here was sealed. Is the drawer in the other bedroom?

Xiaoxiao toppled forward as though trying to crawl away. When Chen Ge picked her up, he noticed her hand pointing beyond Room 304. He initially dismissed the gesture, but as he crossed the living room, he happened to glance through the open door.

Both apartments stood open. Between their doors waited a hunched old woman, silently facing Room 304. Wrinkles covered her face like rings in ancient wood. Chen Ge stopped and instinctively concealed the hammer behind his back.

“Elder, are you a tenant here?” Chen Ge kept his voice calm and collected. The old lady did not answer Chen Ge. She was not even looking at Chen Ge but at the drawers that Chen Ge had pried open with force.

“It’s getting late. Elder, your family will be worried about you if you don’t return home.”

An elderly woman standing silently in a dark corridor could hardly be ordinary. Had she been younger, Chen Ge would not have hesitated to greet her with the hammer.

“Did you open those drawers?” Her hoarse voice sounded like bark grinding against bark.

“Yes, I plan to buy these two rooms, and now I’m arranging the furniture.” Chen Ge kept his gaze on the old lady. If she did anything suspicious, he would summon Xu Yin.

“You should leave immediately and find a good doctor. She may already have attached herself to you.” Having delivered the warning, the old woman turned away, moving slowly on unsteady feet.

“Attached herself to me? What do you mean?” Chen Ge followed her toward the stairs. The old woman pointed back at Room 304. “An English teacher once lived there. She was beautiful and had a lovely voice.

“In the end, she was killed by her lover. She was chopped into pieces and hidden inside the drawers. She was discovered a long time after her death, so she bore great resentment. She haunts everyone who lives here.”

“An English teacher?” Her account matched the information he possessed, suggesting that she was telling the truth. Yet one question remained: why was an old woman waiting outside the apartment in the middle of the night?

“Elder, why would you tell me all this?” Chen Ge stood under the light and did not follow her down the stairs. He asked, “Can you tell me how you know these things?”

“I live in the next building. The English teacher was my daughter.” The old woman’s expression fell, sorrow entering her voice.

“You’re the third one. She has done many bad things, and I don’t want her to do it anymore.

“Leave, don’t stay in that room any longer.”

She continued downstairs at a pace slow enough for Chen Ge to follow.

“But I still have a question.” Chen Ge was about to ask who the other two victims were when he received a message on his phone. It was from the female agent.

“Do you know why the tenants at that residential area don’t dare make any noise and turn off their lights so early at night? There’s an old lady haunting the place, and she tries to find her way home by following the light and noise!”

After reading the message, Chen Ge raised his head. The old woman stood at the corner of the stairwell. The wrinkles on her face were folded together, and she said in a creepy voice, “Come with me. That room is very dangerous.”

Chen Ge’s gaze shifted between his phone and the woman. As the pieces assembled in his mind, he dropped his backpack. None of them can be trusted—but I don’t need to trust any of them.

He summoned Xu Yin and tightened his grip around the hammer. “I’m just here to retrieve the thing that I’ve won. I’m really not interested in your stories.”
